jurisdiction_note: India-wide suggestions only. Responsibility varies by state, district, municipality, and local delegation; users must verify the public authority locally.

departments.name: Municipal Administration / Urban Local Body
departments.parent_authority: Municipal Corporation, Municipality, or Urban Local Body
departments.description: Local roads, street lights, garbage collection, drainage, public spaces, sanitation and municipal water services where locally assigned.
departments.authority_hint: Local municipal office or relevant ward office; confirm the designated Public Information Officer (PIO).

departments.name: Public Works Department / Roads Authority
departments.parent_authority: State PWD, highways authority, or road-owning agency
departments.description: State roads, bridges, public buildings and road works where the relevant agency owns or maintains the asset.
departments.authority_hint: Identify the road owner first; highways may be maintained by a state PWD, NHAI, municipality, or another agency.

departments.name: Water Supply / Public Health Engineering
departments.parent_authority: Municipal water board, water supply department, or state water agency
departments.description: Piped water supply, water quality, water connections, water pressure and supply schedules.
departments.authority_hint: Water responsibility differs by locality; check the municipal body or state water board.

departments.name: Electricity Distribution Utility
departments.description: Power supply, outages, distribution lines, meters, billing and electrical safety issues involving the distribution utility.
departments.authority_hint: Use the local DISCOM for supply and billing; street-light maintenance may instead be municipal.

departments.name: School Education Department
departments.parent_authority: State School Education Department or relevant public education authority
departments.description: Government schools, teachers, scholarships, school infrastructure, admissions and education programme records.
departments.authority_hint: Identify whether the school is managed by the state, local body, central government, or another authority.

departments.name: Police Department
departments.description: Police records, FIR status, traffic enforcement and policing matters subject to applicable exemptions and procedures.
departments.authority_hint: Police is generally a state/UT subject; sensitive records may be exempt or restricted.

departments.name: Public Health / Health Department
departments.parent_authority: State Health Department, public hospital, or relevant health authority
departments.description: Government hospitals, public health facilities, health programme records and public health services.
departments.authority_hint: Choose the authority that administers the specific facility or programme.

departments.name: Transport Department / Public Transport Authority
departments.parent_authority: State Transport Department, RTO, or public transport agency
departments.description: Driving licences, vehicle registration, permits, bus services and transport department records.
departments.authority_hint: Bus services and roads may be run by different authorities; identify the operator.

departments.name: Revenue Department / Land Records
departments.parent_authority: State Revenue Department, Taluk / Tehsil office, or land-records authority
departments.description: Land records, survey, mutation, certificates and revenue administration.
departments.authority_hint: Land-record systems and terminology vary by state; check the local revenue office.

departments.name: Panchayat / Rural Development Department
departments.parent_authority: Gram Panchayat, Block / Panchayat Union, or Rural Development Department
departments.description: Village-level civic works, rural roads, local sanitation, public assets and panchayat expenditure where assigned.
departments.authority_hint: Start with the Gram Panchayat or relevant block/district rural development office, depending on the record.

departments.name: Housing / Urban Development Department
departments.parent_authority: State Housing Board, urban development authority, or housing agency
departments.description: Public housing schemes, allotments, housing-board records and urban development authority matters.
departments.authority_hint: Identify the agency that owns or administers the scheme or property.

departments.name: Environment / Pollution Control Authority
departments.parent_authority: State Pollution Control Board, environment department, or relevant local authority
departments.description: Pollution complaints, environmental permissions, air and water pollution monitoring and related public records.
departments.authority_hint: The appropriate authority depends on the source and type of pollution; local sanitation issues may be municipal.
